metric_definitions.name: final_decision_accuracy
metric_definitions.definition: Fraction of scenarios whose terminal feasibility outcome matches the benchmark label.

metric_definitions.name: hard_constraint_validity
metric_definitions.definition: Fraction of scenarios where the chosen result respects deterministic hard constraints.

metric_definitions.name: cross_domain_compatibility_accuracy
metric_definitions.definition: Fraction of scenarios where cross-resource dependencies are handled correctly.

metric_definitions.name: evidence_grounded_arbitration_accuracy
metric_definitions.definition: Fraction of evidence-relevant scenarios where the controlling evidence and arbitration outcome align with current authoritative evidence.

metric_definitions.name: global_optimum_accuracy
metric_definitions.definition: Fraction of globally-optimizable scenarios where the chosen combination is the lowest-total-cost viable option.

metric_definitions.name: human_review_calibration
metric_definitions.definition: Fraction of HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED scenarios that the architecture routes to human review.

metric_definitions.name: specialist_call_count
metric_definitions.definition: Total number of specialist recommendations produced by the coordinated path.

metric_definitions.name: coordination_overhead_count
metric_definitions.definition: Total number of explicit coordination/dependency checks performed by the coordinator.

metric_definitions.name: mean_latency_ms
metric_definitions.definition: Mean wall-clock latency per scenario for the architecture.

notes: This experiment is fully offline and deterministic.
It compares a v0.3-style single-planner path against minimal specialist coordination.
No LangGraph, autonomous tool loops, or live model calls are used.
